description: Unlock the padlock on the chest with its key from the near (-Y) stand and swing the shackle open. Leave the other key on its stand. The chest lid does not need to be opened.
count_scope: Eight named tasks; fixed starts, no seeds
split_note: No train/test split exists in this baseline; none invented.

evaluator.scope: Environment-owned success and 1 on success else 0.9 x state progress. Default unlock keeps open-padlock-v1; new tasks use lockkey-tasks-v1. Not physical qualification.

qualification: Defined task catalogue; does not imply every variation passed physical qualification.

task_set_v1.score_rule: 1 if success else 0.9 x progress; zero at each untouched constructed start
task_set_v1.qualification: Code and constructed-state checks only; not yet run with the simulator (no settle, contact, render or policy run).

task_set.score_rule: 1 if success else 0.9 x progress; zero at each untouched or idle settled start
task_set.qualification: Constructed-state tests, plus the start settle, idle-drift and render checks of the fix round: all eight untouched starts unsuccessful at score 0. No policy run.
task_set.note: Render-checked eight-task set. Same tasks, instructions, success predicates and difficulty order as task_set_v1; the seven additions select contract lockkey-tasks-v2 and their task ids carry it; unlock keeps its released selection {} (splits/test.json) and contract open-padlock-v1. Differs from v1: the four constructed free-key starts (turn-to-open, swing-open, remove-key, return-key) are settled hands-off for 0.5 s and checked at task setup, which raises instead of serving an invalid start; return-key's key lies at (0.15, -0.20) pitched 2.735 deg tip-down so that it rests on its blade tip and bow; progress zero points are read from the settled start with idle margins (shackle offset +0.5 mm, plug +0.5 deg, withdrawal +0.5 mm, key tilt -5 deg), reported as zero_points; the unlock chain is reported as unlock_chain_reading instead of top-level lock_progress/stage.
